claims: Instagram is currently experiencing a widespread outage as of March 2026.
The outage primarily affects direct messages (DMs) and feed loading for thousands of users globally.
Users are reporting that messages fail to send.
Users are reporting that feeds will not refresh.
The majority of issues stem from the mobile app.
Inability to send/receive DMs is the most common issue.
Feed refresh failures are a main issue.
Login issues are a main issue.
The outage is widespread affecting users in the US and globally.
Outage reports surged in the early hours of the morning (EDT).
The outage continued to affect users later in the day.
The outage is specific to Instagram.
